facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition, Posts and Electronic Communications carries out the activities entered in the twelve digital-transformation chantiers to 2030 under the missions assigned to it, and the Prime Minister conducted its half-year evaluation on 25 July 2026.
facts.system: douze chantiers de la transformation digitale à l'horizon 2030

facts.fact: The half-year evaluation reports an execution rate at 30 June 2026 and activity counts (120 platforms inventoried for repatriation, 220 business licences dematerialised, a government network design finalised) for the twelve chantiers, without giving the rate against stated targets in the article text.
facts.system: douze chantiers de la transformation digitale à l'horizon 2030

facts.fact: On 25 July 2026 the Prime Minister's half-year evaluation recorded the repatriation of data from 120 inventoried platforms to the two new national data centres under the twelve chantiers, with completion intended before end-2026.
facts.system: douze chantiers de la transformation digitale à l'horizon 2030
